items.title: WoW: Forever Hotfixes - November 16, 2026
items.summary: WoW: Forever Hotfixes - November 16, 2026 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Camping The Fishing Rack now provides lures for everyone. Bloated Fish caught from the Fishing Rack effect have had their drop chance increased and their loot tables adjusted accordingly. Classes Druid Fixed an issue where ranks of Wild Growth were not going on cooldown. Balance Fixed an issue where the Genesis talent was not increasing the damage of Pounce's bleed. Priest Fixed an issue where Dark Inspiration was stacking if there were multiple Shadow priests in the same party. [With scheduled weekly maintenance] Vampiric Embrace healing is now based on 10% of the Shadow damage done by the casting Priest (was 20%). The casting Priest receives 100% increased healing from this effect. Developers’ notes: This change results in no difference for Priest solo play. Rogue Rogue Poison ranks can no longer go above the maximum rank. Fixed an issue where using Shank on a target that didn't have your combo points active on them would remove your combo points on other targets, even if Boot Knife wasn't talented. Shaman Fixed an issue where Windfury Totem attacks were ignoring armor and had no internal cooldown. Fixed an issue causing Windfury Totem extra attacks to not generate Rage. Fixed an issue where Mutilate and Execute would have an extra attempt to activate Windfury Totem. Fix

items.title: Player-Level Dungeon XP Adjustment - November 14
items.summary: Player-Level Dungeon XP Adjustment - November 14 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Yesterday, we updated dungeon play so that experience granted by an enemy in an instance is nullified if a high level player is in the group and enemy is trivial to that player. For some dungeons, the new restriction missed the mark because of the overall level range of the enemies in the dungeon. With hotfixes that are now live, we’ve just deployed a further change to this restriction, making it so that the XP nullification only kicks in when the high-level player is more than 12 levels above the level of the enemies. Please note that this adjustment will not apply in instances that were already underway when it was deployed (a few minutes ago). Thank you very much!

items.title: Raid Encounter Design in Midnight Season 3
items.summary: Raid Encounter Design in Midnight Season 3 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Last week we made several adjustments to The Venomous Abyss with the intent of reducing the number of damage events that could kill you or your entire raid with a single individual mistake. We believe this type of severe mechanical penalty was used too often in The Venomous Abyss, causing the associated mechanics to become frustrating as the season wore on. Our goal with these changes was to ensure that damage events feel more proportional to player mistakes and to reduce the number of instances where individual mistakes could easily trigger group wipes. A couple examples from that list of changes: Malice damage was reduced by 45% on Mythic and 63% on Normal/Heroic, which should now help a failed interrupt feel like a punishing but recoverable group mistake. Reductions to Noxious Splash’s initial damage (33%) and damage-over-time component (84%) should help ensure that a single individual’s mistake no longer feels like a death sentence. We feel that our design has shifted over time at the expense of the average Mythic player’s experience. Going forward into Season 3, we’d like to intentionally pull back on some of these severe mechanical penalties, even at the start of the season. items.title: Enhancement Shaman Changes Now Live in WoW: Forever
items.summary: Enhancement Shaman Changes Now Live in WoW: Forever Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Please note: Due to an unexpected delay in deployment, the following changes went live to all regions at 10:45 a.m. PST / 19:45 CET today. Classes Shaman Weapon imbues and Weapon totems can now be used at the same time. Enhancement Stormstrike damage reduced to 100% weapon damage (was 150%), and cooldown increased to 8 seconds (was 6 seconds). Mental Dexterity: Intellect to Attack Power conversion ratio reduced to 33/66/100% (was 50/100/150%). Maelstrom Weapon now grants 20% reduced cast time and Mana cost per application at all ranks (was 4/8/12/16/20% reduced cast time and Mana cost), and chance to activate now increases with rank and activates 6/7/8/9/10 times per minute (was 20 times per minute regardless of rank). Maelstrom Weapon tooltip updated to display the Shaman’s % chance to activate it based on their Main Hand Weapon’s speed. For example, if the Shaman has the 5 points into Maelstrom Weapon and has a 3.6 speed weapon it will display a 60% chance to activate on swing, compared to if the Shaman is wielding a 2.0 speed weapon it will display a 33% chance to activate on swing.
